description: AICTIONBOT™ e-invoice checker by KULIC Advisory (tool 49). Takes the XML of an e-invoice in UBL or UN/CEFACT CII syntax (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD or Factur-X) and reads number, dates, seller, buyer, VAT IDs, purchase order reference, lines, totals, tax per rate and payment details. Checks the mandatory details (red if missing, yellow for purchase order reference, delivery date and IBAN), whether net plus tax equals gross, whether the lines add up to the net total, tax per rate and the amount due, and flags profiles that are not valid as an e-invoice (MINIMUM, BASIC WL). Checks mandatory details and arithmetic, not a full validation against the schema and rules of the standard. Not tax advice. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

xml.description: The XML of the e-invoice (UBL or CII). For ZUGFeRD PDFs the embedded XML file.
